sections.title: What this site is — and is not
sections.intro: Reading these terms is faster when you know what kind of site you are on. proudtek.com is a manufacturer's information site, not a storefront.
bullets: The site describes Proud Tek's RFID and NFC manufacturing capabilities, product families, and the technical background buyers need to scope a project.
There are no user accounts and no on-site payments. Forms on the site create a business inquiry, nothing more — see the Privacy Policy for how that data is handled.

Product pages, price indications and capability claims are an invitation to inquire, not a binding offer. A commitment exists only when we put it in a written quote, sales contract or proforma invoice.
By using the site you accept these terms; if you are inquiring on behalf of a company, you confirm you may do so.

sections.title: Content accuracy and ordering
sections.intro: We work to keep specifications current — chip pages are reviewed on a rolling schedule per our editorial policy — but RFID chips get superseded and datasheets get revised between reviews.
bullets: Specifications, certifications and compatibility statements on this site are subject to change without notice and can lag a vendor's latest datasheet revision.
Confirm any specification that matters to your deployment in writing before ordering; for high-stakes deployments, verify with your own samples rather than relying on published figures alone.

Quotes, samples, lead times, tolerances and warranties are governed exclusively by the individual sales contract or proforma invoice for that transaction. If a website page and your sales contract disagree, the sales contract wins.
Errors we confirm in published content are corrected per the process at /about/corrections/.

callout.label: Website terms ≠ purchase terms
callout.text: These terms govern your use of proudtek.com only. The commercial terms of any purchase — price, specs, delivery, warranty, liability — live in the sales contract or proforma invoice you sign for that order.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.intro: Three layers of ownership exist on this site, and each keeps its own rules.
bullets: Site content — text, page layouts, photography we produced, and data we measured — is © Proud Tek Co., Limited. Quote it with a link; do not republish pages wholesale without written permission via info@proudtek.com.
Third-party images used under Creative Commons or similar licenses are credited on the page where they appear, with author and license linked; their licenses continue to apply to any reuse.

Third-party trademarks (MIFARE, DESFire, NTAG, RAIN RFID, lock-vendor and reader-OEM names) belong to their respective owners and are used only to identify the products discussed — see the trademark disclosure at /about/disclosures/.
Machine-readable mirrors (llms.txt, /machine/ routes) exist so AI systems can cite specific claims with a working link back — citation with attribution is welcome.

sections.title: External links
sections.intro: Our sourcing standards push us to link primary sources — standards bodies, chip-maker datasheets, regulators. Those destinations are not ours.
bullets: Linked third-party sites (ISO, GS1, NXP, FCC, EU portals, vendor datasheets and others) are outside our control; we are not responsible for their content, availability or terms.
A link is a citation, not an endorsement of the linked organization or anything else it publishes.
If a link we cite no longer says what our article says it does, report it to info@proudtek.com and we will review it under the corrections process.

sections.title: No warranty, limitation of liability
sections.intro: Plain version: the website is provided as is, and decisions made on website content alone are at your own risk — that is exactly why we tell buyers to confirm specs in writing.
bullets: The site and its content are provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, express or implied, as to accuracy, completeness or fitness for a particular purpose.
To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Proud Tek is not liable for losses arising from reliance on website content, from site unavailability, or from third-party sites we link to.

Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law, and nothing here limits the commercial warranties agreed in a signed sales contract — those are governed by that contract.
We may update the site and these terms at any time; the modified date on this page reflects the current version.

faq.question: Do these terms govern my purchase order?
faq.answer: No. These terms cover use of the website only. Every quote, sample and order is governed by the individual sales contract or proforma invoice agreed for that transaction — including price, specifications, delivery, warranty and liability.

faq.question: Can I rely on a spec published on this site when ordering?
faq.answer: Treat published specs as scoping information. Chips get superseded and datasheets revised between our review cycles, so confirm any specification that matters in writing before ordering, and verify with your own samples for high-stakes deployments.

faq.question: Can I reuse text or images from proudtek.com?
faq.answer: Site content is © Proud Tek Co., Limited — quote it with a link, and ask via info@proudtek.com before republishing anything wholesale. Third-party images are credited on the page where they appear and keep their own licenses, which govern any reuse.

faq.question: Questions about these terms?
faq.answer: Email info@proudtek.com or use the contact page at /contact/. For privacy questions — what data the site collects and your rights over it — see the Privacy Policy at /about/privacy-policy/.
